class.name: TamaServerBulletConfig
class.brief_description: A Resource that configures the appearance and collision of a server bullet type.
class.description:
[b]TamaServerBulletConfig[/b] defines the visual and physics properties for a server bullet type registered via [method TamaManager.register_server_bullet].
Server bullets are rendered as a [MultiMesh] and collide through the physics server directly, making them suitable for large bullet counts (hundreds to thousands on screen simultaneously).
Create one [TamaServerBulletConfig] per distinct bullet appearance and register it once at startup.

members.member: The texture drawn for each bullet in this type.

When [code]true[/code] (default), [member rect] is automatically derived from the texture size whenever [member texture] is assigned. For a 14×8 texture this produces [code]Rect2(-7, -4, 14, 8)[/code]. Set to [code]false[/code] to specify [member rect] manually.

The local-space rectangle that defines the rendered quad size and pivot offset. Only used when [member auto_rect] is [code]false[/code]; when [member auto_rect] is [code]true[/code] this value is overwritten automatically and shown read-only in the inspector.
Scales the texture relative to [member rect]. Use this to animate or shrink/grow the sprite without changing the collision shape.
Radius of the circular collision shape in pixels.
The physics layer this bullet type exists on.
The physics layers this bullet type detects overlaps with.
When [code]true[/code], each bullet is visually rotated to match its movement angle.
Maximum number of bullets of this type that can be alive simultaneously. Bullets fired beyond this limit are silently dropped.
